body.title: refractor: introduce typed error handling across core modules
body.body: ## Summary - What does this PR change? This PR introduces error-handling strategy across `nexum_core` library. It replaces loosely typed errors with structured error types. - Why is it needed? - The previous error handling mixed anyhow with implicit conversions. This enables callers to reliably distinguish error cases.
